# lakekeeper_generic_tables (Data Source)

List the generic (non-Iceberg) tables in one namespace, sorted by name. Verifies the warehouse belongs to the project. No resources or permissions are changed.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/generic-table/#tag/generic-table/operation/list_generic_tables)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lakekeeper_generic_tables" "images" {
  project_id   = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
  warehouse_id = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
  namespace    = "ml.images"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Dotted namespace path, including all parent levels.
- `project_id` (String) Project UUID.
- `warehouse_id` (String) Warehouse UUID; names are not used to select warehouses.

### Read-Only

- `tables` (Attributes List) Generic tables in the namespace, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tables))

<a id="nestedatt--tables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tables`

Read-Only:

- `format` (String) Table format, for example `lance`, `delta` or `dataset`.
- `id` (String) Generic table UUID used by the protection and permission APIs.
- `name` (String) Name of the generic table.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace levels of the table.
